title: Infineon Completes C2i Semiconductors Acquisition to Boost AI Data Center Power Solutions
source_used: Infineon's own press release of 5 Oct 2026 (original of the Bisinfotech relay in the pool); announcement release of 24 Aug 2026 for background
key_facts: Infineon Technologies AG (Munich) announced on 5 Oct 2026 that it has completed its acquisition of C2i Semiconductors, a Bengaluru-based company specialising in software-defined multiphase controllers and smart power stages for AI data-centre applications.
With completion, the C2i team becomes part of Infineon's Power Systems division.
Adam White, president of Infineon's Power Systems division, called completion 'an important milestone for our AI power business and our innovation activities in India'.

Infineon says software-defined power solutions combine power semiconductors with digital control and software to manage power conversion in real time, as AI processors create rapidly changing power demands.
The combined teams will work on power delivery for AI infrastructure, including future Substrate Integrated Voltage Regulators (SIVR).
Infineon employs approximately 2,800 people in India.
The deal was first announced on 24 Aug 2026, when closing was expected in the third quarter of calendar 2026; neither release gives a price or financial terms.
The pool item is Bisinfotech's relay of this release (6 Oct 2026).
quote_evidence: Infineon Technologies AG (FSE: IFX / OTCQX: IFNNY) today announced the completion of its acquisition of C2i Semiconductors, a Bengaluru-based technology company specializing in software-defined multiphase controllers and smart power stages for AI data center applications.
With the completion of the transaction, the C2i Semiconductors team becomes part of Infineon’s Power Systems division.
The transaction is expected to close in the third quarter of calendar year 2026.
why_it_matters_hint: Infineon adds a Bengaluru team and software-based power-control technology to its AI data-centre power business.
